scenarios.description: MAP mode for a Nites uphill market produces mmf-matrix.md + mmf-batch-1.md with 7-column matrix, 5 experiments, and 3k/12k barbell math cited.
preconditions: docs/marketing-context.md exists with primary_entity including Nites
docs/campaigns/nites/ directory absent on disk (MAP creates it on first write)
no pre-existing mmf-matrix.md for nites
scenarios.prompt: Invoke message-market-fit. Gate 2: select MAP. Gate 3: entity=Nites. MAP Step 1: pipeline environment=uphill. Proceed through Steps 2–6 and write outputs.
expected_assertions: output_contains: 'docs/campaigns/nites/mmf-matrix.md'
output_contains: 'docs/campaigns/nites/mmf-batch-1.md'
output_contains: '| Market | Segment | Persona | Angle | Batch | Verdict | Notes |'
output_contains: '3,000' OR output_contains: '3k experiment'
output_contains: '12,000' OR output_contains: '12k safe'
mmf-batch-1.md contains exactly 5 experiment hypothesis cards
every hypothesis card contains the sub-fields: hypothesis, what_works, what_we_learn_if_it_fails, list_build_notes
exactly 2 files written under docs/campaigns/nites/

scenarios.description: ITERATE picked at Gate 2 but no campaign-analysis artifact on disk — skill's first response is the verbatim halt message and zero tool calls fire beyond the Glob prereq check.
preconditions: no match for docs/campaigns/{entity}/analysis-*.md (Glob returns empty)
operator selects ITERATE at §2 Gate 2
operator selects entity=nites at §2 Gate 3
scenarios.prompt: Invoke message-market-fit. Gate 2: select ITERATE. Gate 3: entity=Nites. Then attempt to proceed.
expected_assertions: first_response contains the exact string: 'ITERATE mode requires a campaign-analysis artifact at'
first_response contains the exact string: 'Run `campaign-analysis` first, then resume.'
first_tool_calls contains the Glob prereq check and nothing else
no Write tool call fires
no artifact is written under docs/campaigns/nites/
skill does NOT fall back to MAP mode (no MAP Step 1 pipeline-environment question)

scenarios.description: DIAGNOSE with 2 flat batches — Step 1 clean, Step 2 fails — diagnosis names Segment as root cause, does NOT continue past Step 2, hands off to creative-angles.
preconditions: docs/campaigns/nites/ contains at least 2 mmf-results-*.md files showing flat performance
docs/campaigns/nites/analysis-*.md artifact available
mocked Step 1 evidence: peer companies buying the category (Market clean)
mocked Step 2 evidence: replies scattered with no consistent objection pattern (Segment wrong)
scenarios.prompt: Invoke message-market-fit. Gate 2: select DIAGNOSE. Gate 3: entity=Nites. Proceed with the 5-step ordered sequence.
expected_assertions: output_contains: 'mmf-diagnosis-' under docs/campaigns/nites/
diagnosis frontmatter contains: mode: diagnose
diagnosis body names Segment as the root cause (Step 2)
diagnosis prescription hands off to creative-angles
diagnosis does NOT include analysis of Step 3 (Persona), Step 4 (Angle), or Step 5 (Execution)
only one root cause is reported per run
output_contains: 'First failure in the ordered sequence IS the root cause' OR equivalent anchor

scenarios.description: Every verdict cell across MAP and ITERATE matrix outputs uses exactly one of the five fixed tokens — scenario fails on any prose substitute.
preconditions: a run producing a matrix update with at least 3 rows carrying a Verdict cell
mocked classification outputs ranging across SUPER WORKS, KIND OF WORKS, DOESN'T WORK, DEFERRED, PENDING
scenarios.prompt: Invoke message-market-fit in any mode that updates the matrix Verdict column. Produce the matrix.
expected_assertions: every Verdict cell value is in the set {'SUPER WORKS', 'KIND OF WORKS', 'DOESN'T WORK', 'DEFERRED', 'PENDING'}
output does NOT contain any of: 'promising', 'mediocre', 'decent', 'worth another look', 'pretty strong', 'kind of worked'
verdict labels rendered in uppercase exactly as listed (no 'kind of works' lowercase)
zero prose substitutes appear in the Verdict column

scenarios.description: Across a MAP → ITERATE pair (Batch-1 followed by Batch-2 next-design), the 20% experiment allocation never zeroes out and the 80/20 ratio holds in every batch design.
preconditions: MAP Batch-1 has shipped with 5 experiments × 600 contacts = 3,000 experiment volume
safe side running at 12,000 for 80/20 parity
campaign-analysis artifact available for ITERATE Batch-2 design
scenarios.prompt: Invoke message-market-fit MAP for Batch-1, then message-market-fit ITERATE for Batch-2 design. Preserve the barbell.
expected_assertions: Batch-1 experiment volume is 3,000 (or near 3,000 with documented rounding)
Batch-1 safe volume is 12,000 (4× experiment volume for 80/20)
Batch-2 design preserves the experiment side (experiment volume > 0)
Batch-2 design preserves the 80/20 ratio (safe ≈ 4× experiment)
output_contains reference to Kellen's Law #6 OR 'Never stop the experiment side'
no batch design shows experiment allocation below 20% of total volume

scenarios.description: All 10 Kellen's Laws appear verbatim in §3 `### 10 Kellen's Laws` subsection AND as `Do not X` rules in §8 `**Kellen's Laws as hard failures**` block — requires Read of SKILL.md to cross-check.
preconditions: plugins/marketing/skills/message-market-fit/SKILL.md exists and is readable
§3 `### 10 Kellen's Laws` subsection present with numbered laws 1–10
§8 `**Kellen's Laws as hard failures**` block present with 10 `Do not X` rules
scenarios.prompt: Read plugins/marketing/skills/message-market-fit/SKILL.md and verify the 10-law cross-reference invariant between §3 and §8.
expected_assertions: Read tool call fires on 'plugins/marketing/skills/message-market-fit/SKILL.md'
§3 contains the substring 'Resonance beats personalization' (Law #1)
§3 contains the substring 'Identity beats information' (Law #2)
§3 contains the substring 'Groups are cultural, not demographic' (Law #3)
§3 contains the substring 'The things that work and the things you wanted to work are not synonymous' (Law #4)
§3 contains the substring 'Silence is data' (Law #5)
§3 contains the substring 'Never stop the experiment side' (Law #6)
§3 contains the substring 'Qualitative beats quantitative' (Law #7)
§3 contains the substring 'Wrong-and-specific is worse than wrong-and-general' (Law #8)
§3 contains the substring 'The best campaigns look nothing like what you planned' (Law #9)
§3 contains the substring 'Outbound is how we discover, validate, and invalidate hypotheses' (Law #10)
§8 contains exactly 10 `Do not X` rules under the `**Kellen's Laws as hard failures**` header, each citing its law number (Law #1 through Law #10)

scenarios.description: MAP for Nites routes Email Bison calls to mcp__emailbison-personal__*; MAP for Supply or Labs routes to mcp__emailbison-b2b__* — requires inspection of the tool-call trace.
preconditions: Email Bison MCP servers registered at both namespaces (mcp__emailbison-personal__* and mcp__emailbison-b2b__*)
entity selection through §2 Gate 3
scenarios.prompt: Invoke message-market-fit MAP for entity=Nites, capture the tool-call trace. Then invoke message-market-fit MAP for entity=Supply, capture the trace. Then entity=Labs, capture the trace.
expected_assertions: for entity=Nites: every mcp__emailbison-* tool call in the trace uses the mcp__emailbison-personal__ prefix
for entity=Nites: zero mcp__emailbison-b2b__ tool calls appear in the trace
for entity=Supply: every mcp__emailbison-* tool call in the trace uses the mcp__emailbison-b2b__ prefix
for entity=Supply: zero mcp__emailbison-personal__ tool calls appear in the trace
for entity=Labs: every mcp__emailbison-* tool call in the trace uses the mcp__emailbison-b2b__ prefix
for entity=Labs: zero mcp__emailbison-personal__ tool calls appear in the trace
trace inspection is against the tool-call log (mcp__emailbison-personal__* vs mcp__emailbison-b2b__* namespaces)

scenarios.description: ITERATE on an entity with a pre-existing mmf-matrix.md containing 3 batch rows appends Results Log rows and does NOT rewrite the body — requires before/after diff of the matrix file.
preconditions: docs/campaigns/nites/mmf-matrix.md exists with 3 batch rows in the main matrix body
docs/campaigns/nites/analysis-*.md artifact available for ITERATE
operator selects ITERATE at §2 Gate 2 with entity=nites and batch reference=batch-3
scenarios.prompt: Invoke message-market-fit ITERATE for entity=Nites with batch reference=batch-3. Capture the file state before and after the run.
expected_assertions: before/after diff of docs/campaigns/nites/mmf-matrix.md is inspected
post-run file contains the 3 original batch rows byte-for-byte unchanged
post-run file contains new Results Log rows appended after the original body
post-run file Results Log section contains a markdown table with columns: Batch / Experiment / Reply% / Meeting% / Verdict / Transferable Insight
row order of the original 3 batch rows is preserved (no re-ordering)
no original matrix row was deleted, edited, or replaced
diff target file path: docs/campaigns/nites/mmf-matrix.md
